items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: and I used to hang around Fats and go into theatres and listen to him play and then go out somewhere, I'd be right with him, see.

ctx.x: So before the phone rang, you were talking about Fats Waller, and you had this derby, and he had this long coat with the checks.
Yeah, and I had a pocketful of money and I used to hang around Fats and go into theatres and listen to him play and then go out somewhere, I'd be right with him, see.
